selection: 38 current logical collection cases plus six distinct explicit robot-matrix exemplars. Historical failures and cube-jaw fixtures excluded; current failed recipes retained.
criteria_note: Applicability is declared before trials. Numerical acceptance limits remain governed by the comparison protocol; this registry does not convert smoke outcomes to passes.
hold_extension: Extend only declared free-grasp stationary holds to60s. Keep frame interval/substeps/material/contact fixed. Analytic load/stack cases retain their declared windows.

baseline_cost.timing_scope: Includes setup, compilation, audits, capture and encoding; not pure solver time.
